title: The Home page
request: Home is where a problem becomes a solution: the user writes one sentence (or asks for any kind of model), brings data or not, and while the data is structured, cleaned and described in the background, a chat at the bottom asks a few questions about the real problem and an agent draws a solution workflow for this specific problem that follows the conversation. This package wires Home itself, in the demo's look: the composer, 'Connect data' and the 'Bring the data' card, the chat thread, the solution workflow card, the pack cards, and real counts.
spec: The composer that starts a draft and keeps the user on Home; 'Connect data' and a 'Bring the data' card (Upload, Studied samples, Kaggle, Hugging Face, Warehouse, Synthetic); the chat with pipeline progress and analysis cards; the solution workflow card; the optional pack picker; the Projects and Activity tabs and 'Needs you' on real data. Done when, in the browser, one sentence plus a file leads to cleaning steps, an analysis card, a question with the right outcome first and a redrawn workflow, with no console error.
plan: Reuse the intern's thread markup for the chat, the wizard's data-source tabs for the 'Bring the data' card, .stats and the existing charts for the analysis card.
Show the pipeline as a tool-call block, questions as ask-cards answered with one click, and streamed replies inserted as text.
Move the project graph renderer into DC.graph with automatic layout and redraw the workflow on every workflow event.
Fill the stats, Projects, Activity and 'Needs you' from /api/workspace; remember the open draft across reloads.
Drive the flow in the browser like a user: one sentence, a file, the answers, 'Let's build the solution'.

decisions.decision: Every new piece reuses an existing component.
decisions.why: The owner asked for the demo's UI unchanged; new parts must look like they were always there.

decisions.decision: 'Let's build the solution' hands the draft to the wizard instead of creating the project itself.
decisions.why: The wizard is where the user checks the solution, the split and the budget before anything runs.

decisions.decision: The top-bar pill reads 'Your data' on Home and in the wizard.
decisions.why: It tells the user they are no longer looking at sample content.

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/home.html wired to the draft API and its event stream; DC.graph, DC.connectors and DC.synthetic in core.js; Home's Activity tab lists real jobs and the newest evidence records.

measurements.name: browser walk-through
measurements.gate: One sentence plus an uploaded file leads to cleaning steps, an analysis card, a question with the right outcome column first and a redrawn workflow, with no console error.
measurements.result: Walked through in the browser with the Telco CSV: the steps, the analysis card and the questions appeared, the workflow redrew, and no console error was logged; the outcome ordering was corrected in 3.7.

outcome: Done: Home starts a real flow in the demo's look, with real counts and an Activity tab on real jobs.
lessons: Reuse existing markup for new features when the design is frozen: the result is consistent and the review is small.
